languageDetection.reason: The detection skill matches marker files at the REPO ROOT only. This is a monorepo with no root package.json or tsconfig.json, so auto-detection returned 'generic'. TypeScript is correct: 7 tsconfig.json files under apps/ and services/, 165 non-test .ts source files. Swift is a second language (native/evidence-core-swift, 26 .swift files) that this plugin has no adapter for.

frameworkDetection.reason: No mkdocs.yml, .vitepress/, docusaurus.config.*, or conf.py. docs/ exists with 94 real .md files, so priority-5 plain-markdown applies.

hookStrictnessRationale: Chosen after consulting Codex. Two independent reasons converge on 'off':

1. Zero of 165 source files currently map to a doc. Per-commit strictness would therefore measure whether a documentation architecture exists, not whether documentation drifted. A warning that fires on every commit teaches the maintainer to ignore it, and lets the repo claim a control it does not have.

2. Verified in the plugin source: scripts/docs-guardian/commit-guard.js:143 reads '// Always warn, never block' and returns permissionDecision:'allow' unconditionally. The documented 'block' level does not block. Selecting it would create exactly the false assurance this repo removed its own hook layer over on 2026-08-10 and again on 2026-08-12.
Re-evaluate when mapped/total source files exceeds 80% AND an audit produces few false positives. Measure that mechanically in CI, not from memory.
stalenessNote: Plugin default, chosen by the maintainer. Expect most of the 60 ADRs to flag on the first audit: they are durable decision records, intentionally unchanged for long periods. An ADR does not rot with age — it rots when the code it describes changes.
coverageScopeNote: Chosen by the maintainer after being told coverage reports 0% today and that /docs-guardian:generate would propose roughly 165 new files. Treat the first coverage number as a baseline to work down, not as a defect count.
mappingsNote: Empty on purpose. All four mapping strategies were applied: no config mappings existed, plain-markdown provides no framework convention, convention-based matching returned 0 hits across 165 source files, and no external doc layer exists to map to. Add entries here as documentation is written.
excludeNote: docs/contracts is NOT excluded as a source root — case-box-contract/src is a real published package and its public API is the most doc-worthy code here. But its node_modules and dist are excluded, and it must never be treated as doc CONTENT: it is a package consumed by services via file: and shipped to the desktop as a committed tarball.
docKindsNote: This repo has no API-documentation layer. docs/ holds 60 ADRs, 24 release gates, 2 merged product documents, and a few UI drafts. Any audit should read these as decision and product records, not as code documentation.
sourcesNote: Globs must include *.mts: apps/lawbar-desktop/electron/preload.mts is the contextBridge trust boundary and was outside configured scope until 2026-08-12, so coverage runs reported it as neither documented nor undocumented — it simply did not exist to the tool.
